question: In what locus is the wind-filling air said to be situated according to this description?
premises: There is an air described as wind-filling.
That air is said to be situated.
Its locus is stated as in all beings.
inference: The wind-filling air is present and situated in all beings.
uncertainties: The relation between this air and the haṃsa of verse 108 is not stated here.
plain_english: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
